item.text: I’ll switch GNOME notifications into Do Not Disturb by changing the desktop notification setting directly.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners false && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners'
/bin/bash -lc 'gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners false && gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners'

item.text: Do Not Disturb is now enabled. GNOME notification banners are turned off (`show-banners` is `false`).
